canDoYue: 你識講年假日期、邊個接手、交接、批核、電郵確認同公眾假期。
canDoEn: Ask for annual leave, name who covers the desk, send a handover, and ask for email approval around a public holiday.

dialogue.speaker: sora
dialogue.text: I would like annual leave from Monday through Friday next week, and I can send those dates.
dialogue.glossYue: 我想下星期星期一至星期五請年假，我可以送呢啲日期。
dialogue.say: I would like annual leave from Monday through Friday next week, and I can send those dates.

dialogue.speaker: niles
dialogue.text: Which dates do you want for this annual leave, and who will cover your desk next week?
dialogue.glossYue: 你想請年假邊幾日，下星期邊個睇你張檯？
dialogue.say: Which dates do you want for this annual leave, and who will cover your desk next week?

dialogue.speaker: sora
dialogue.text: I want leave from Monday to Friday next week, and Jo will cover the desk after handover.
dialogue.glossYue: 我想下星期星期一至星期五放假，Jo 會喺交接之後睇張檯。
dialogue.say: I want leave from Monday to Friday next week, and Jo will cover the desk after handover.

dialogue.speaker: niles
dialogue.text: Please send that handover note by email, and I can approve the dates after I read it.
dialogue.glossYue: 請用電郵送交接筆記，我睇完就可以批核日期。
dialogue.say: Please send that handover note by email, and I can approve the dates after I read it.

dialogue.speaker: sora
dialogue.text: Can you approve those dates once the note is ready, and will you email me a reply?
dialogue.glossYue: 筆記準備好可唔可以批核日期，你會唔會電郵覆我？
dialogue.say: Can you approve those dates once the note is ready, and will you email me a reply?

dialogue.speaker: niles
dialogue.text: I will approve the dates, and I will email you once the public holiday list is clear.
dialogue.glossYue: 我會批核日期，公眾假期清單清楚之後我會電郵你。
dialogue.say: I will approve the dates, and I will email you once the public holiday list is clear.

dialogue.speaker: sora
dialogue.text: Wednesday is a public holiday in that week, so I will start my handover on Tuesday morning.
dialogue.glossYue: 嗰個星期星期三係公眾假期，所以我星期二朝早先開始交接。
dialogue.say: Wednesday is a public holiday in that week, so I will start my handover on Tuesday morning.

dialogue.speaker: niles
dialogue.text: Please email me the full handover on Tuesday, and annual leave can start after that written note.
dialogue.glossYue: 請星期二將完整交接電郵畀我，睇完筆記就可以開始年假。
dialogue.say: Please email me the full handover on Tuesday, and annual leave can start after that written note.
